rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that a quality belongs to something by its own nature.

example.english: This design is inherently practical, so there is no need to add lots of fancy extras.
example.traditional: 呢個設計本身已經好實用，唔使再加咁多花巧嘢。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 bun2 san1 ji5 ging1 hou2 sat6 jung6 m4 sai2 zoi3 gaa1 gam3 do1 faa1 haau2 je5

rows.note: Use this when “inherently” specifically means innate or present from birth.

example.english: They are inherently shy around strangers and always hide when they meet someone new.
example.traditional: 佢天生就怕生，見到陌生人總係匿埋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tin1 saang1 zau6 paa3 saang1 gin3 dou2 mak6 sang1 jan4 zung2 hai6 nei1 maai4
